description.value: Mon Thong Thai Restaurant bills itself as the first and best Thai restaurant in Kelowna and the broader Okanagan area. Located on Cooper Road in Kelowna, it operates seven days a week and offers both dine-in and online ordering for pickup or delivery. A touring cyclist seeking a sit-down Thai meal in Kelowna would find a well-established local option here.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is active and operational, with matching address (1876 Cooper Rd, Kelowna, BC V1Y 9N6) and phone number ((250) 860-6809). The website explicitly offers 'Order Online' with both Pickup and Delivery options, confirming takeout. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name is 'Mon Thong' while the website consistently uses 'Mon Thong Thai Restaurant' — the OSM entry may be abbreviated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Thai restaurant in Kelowna with a live website, confirmed address, and online ordering — straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists seeking a meal.

wow_evidence: bills itself as the first and best Thai restaurant in Kelowna
